description: Defines the RawContact class representing contact data with JSON serialization/deserialization methods, used in Android sample sync client.

classes.name: RawContact
classes.description: Represents a low-level contact RawContact with fields like name, phone numbers, email, and JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Indicates if the contact is deleted.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Indicates if the contact is dirty (modified).

methods.name: getBestName
methods.description: Returns the best available name (full, first, or last).

methods.name: toJSONObject
methods.description: Converts the RawContact to a JSON object.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Creates a RawContact instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a RawContact with specified details.

methods.name: createDeletedContact
methods.description: Creates a RawContact representing a deleted contact with minimal info.
